sources.title: Iran Keeps Up Unrelenting Attacks on Ships in the Strait of Hormuz
Iran's IRGC Navy says 2 oil supertankers strike naval mines in Strait of Hormuz

en.title: Iran's IRGC Navy claims oil supertankers struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz
en.dek: Anadolu Ajansı reports two oil supertankers struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz
facts: Anadolu Ajansı reports Iran's IRGC Navy says two oil supertankers struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz
New York Times describes a strike on a ship that had already been disabled
Both reports were published on November 19, 2026
body: Anadolu Ajansı says Iran's IRGC Navy reported that two oil supertankers struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz.
The New York Times reports a recent strike on a ship that had already been disabled.
en.context: Anadolu Ajansı and the New York Times both reported on November 19, 2026, about incidents in the Strait of Hormuz involving oil supertankers.

de.title: Iranische Revolutionsgarde meldet Treffer von Seeminen auf Öltanker in der Straße von Hormus
de.dek: Laut einem Bericht der Nachrichtenagentur Anadolu sind zwei Supertanker in der Straße von Hormus auf Seeminen gelaufen.
facts: Die Nachrichtenagentur Anadolu berichtet, die Marine der iranischen Revolutionsgarde habe mitgeteilt, dass zwei Supertanker in der Straße von Hormus auf Seeminen gelaufen seien.
Die New York Times beschreibt einen Angriff auf ein Schiff, das bereits manövrierunfähig war.
Beide Berichte wurden am 19. November 2026 veröffentlicht.
body: Die Nachrichtenagentur Anadolu Ajansı berichtet, dass die Marine der iranischen Revolutionsgarde gemeldet habe, zwei Supertanker seien in der Straße von Hormus auf Seeminen gelaufen.
Die New York Times berichtet von einem kürzlichen Angriff auf ein Schiff, das bereits manövrierunfähig war.
de.context: Sowohl die Nachrichtenagentur Anadolu als auch die New York Times berichteten am 19. November 2026 über Zwischenfälle mit Öltankern in der Straße von Hormus.

es.title: Irán afirma la Marina de la Guardia Revolucionaria que petroleros golpearon minas navales en el Estrecho de Ormuz
es.dek: Anadolu Ajansı informa que dos petroleros golpearon minas navales en el Estrecho de Ormuz
facts: Anadolu Ajanía informa que la Marina de la Guardia Revolucionaria iraní dice que dos petroleros golpearon minas navales en el Estrecho de Ormuz
El New York Times describe un ataque contra un barco que ya estaba inoperativo

Ambos informes fueron publicados el 19 de noviembre de 2026 @@CONTEXT Anadolu Ajanía y el New York Times informaron el 19 de noviembre de 2026 sobre incidentes en el Estrecho de Ormuz que involucraban petroleros. @@CAPTION
body: Irán afirma la Marina de la Guardia Revolucionaria que petroleros golpearon minas navales en el Estrecho de Ormuz
Anadolu Ajansı dice que la Marina de la Guardia Revolucionaria de Irán informó que dos petroleros tanqueros golpearon minas navales en el Estrecho de Ormuz.

pt.title: A Marinha do IRGC do Irão afirma que superpetroleiros foram atingidos por minas navais no Estreito de Ormuz
pt.dek: A Anadolu Ajência reporta que dois superpetroleiros atingiram minas navais no Estreito de Ormuz
facts: Anadolu Ajência reporta que a Marinha do IRGC do Irão diz que dois superpetroleiros atingiram minas navais no Estreito de Ormuz
O New York Times descreve um ataque a um navio que já estava desativado
Ambos os relatórios foram publicados em 19 de novembro de 2026
body: A Anadolu Ajansısı refere que a Marinha da IRGC do Irão informou que dois petroleiros supertankers atingiram minas navais no Estreito de Ormuz.
O The New York Times refere um recente ataque a um navio que já tinha sido desativado.
pt.context: A Anadolu Ajência e o New York Times ambos reportaram em 19 de novembro de 2026, sobre incidentes no Estreito de Ormuz envolvendo superpetroleiros.

ko.title: 이란 혁명수비대 해군이 호르무즈 해협에서 유조선 2척이 해상 기뢰에 부딪혔다고 주장
ko.dek: 아나돌루 통신, 호르무즈 해협에서 유조선 2척이 해상 기뢰에 부딪혔다고 보도
facts: 아나돌루 통신, 이란 혁명수비대 해군이 호르무즈 해협에서 유조선 2척이 해상 기뢰에 부딪혔다고 주장함
뉴욕타임스, 이미 무력화된 선박에 대한 공격 묘사
body: 이란 혁명수비대 해군이 호르무즈 해협에서 유조선 2척이 해상 기뢰에 부딪혔다고 주장했다.
뉴욕타임스는 최근 선박이 이미 무력화된 상태에서 발생한 공격이라고 보도했다.
ko.context: 아나돌루 통신과 뉴욕타임스는 모두 2026년 11월 19일, 호르무즈 해협과 관련된 유조선 사건에 대해 보도함

problemsFixed: Body paragraph 3 contains unsupported claims about IRGC Navy 'previously being associated with maritime incidents' and altering 'risk profile' — these are not in the sources and constitute speculation.
Body paragraph 2 contains the banned phrase 'may represent a dangerous new phase' (speculation) and 'alter the risk profile' (speculative evaluation).
Paragraph 3 opens with 'The Strait of Hormuz' — same noun that opened paragraph 2, violating rule 13.
The dek uses 'reports' for Anadolu Ajansı's claim, but the source uses 'says'; the NYT text is a paraphrase, not a direct quote, and the dek should not summarize the NYT's interpretive language.
The article ends with an evaluative summary sentence ('Both outlets describe the event on the same date'), which is banned by rule 12.
